about: The Issue 7 board's ICs as Acorn's Service Manual (D1) lists them in table 8.1, "Integrated circuits" (PDF pages 66 and 67, printed pages 56 and 57), transcribed by hand on 13 October 2026 from the page images: each IC's reference, its part as the table prints it, the table's comment, and its PCB position in mm from the SW corner (manualXY, task 5's check). Task 4 added, before its nets check was run, the GND and +5V pins of the ICs that check uses, each with the data sheet it was read from; every other IC says why it is left out. Task 5 completes the file. Facts read from the sources named, not their text.
pages: PDF pages 66 and 67 (printed pages 56 and 57), table 8.1

ics.pinoutSource: Rockwell, "R650X and R651X Microprocessors (CPU)" data sheet, Document No. 29000D39, Rev. 8, June 1987, the R6502's 40-pin pinout on page 3 (http://archive.6502.org/datasheets/rockwell_r650x_r651x.pdf), read 13 October 2026: pin 1 VSS, pin 8 VCC (pin 21 is VSS too). The board's part is the 6502A
